brief: The town's 1987 wooden pier, at 1,954 ft the longest wooden over-water pier on the West Coast: a straight timber-planked deck on tall bents of creosoted timber piles with diagonal bracing, a timber rail with benches and fishermen, tall lamp standards all along, and a widened end carrying a restaurant and bait shop. It runs from the foot of the main street over the beach and surf. Five photos. Piles carried 10 m or more below the modelled bed (spec rule 4).
